tools.name: search_rikishi
tools.description: Search Grand Sumo rikishi by 四股名 (shikona) or 読み (yomi). Returns up to 20 matching rikishi with their ID, name, reading, current rank, and profile URLs.

tools.name: get_rikishi_profile
tools.description: Get detailed profile and career record for a specific rikishi by numeric ID.

tools.name: get_banzuke
tools.description: Get official Grand Sumo banzuke (rankings for makuuchi and juryo divisions). Optionally specify monthKey (YYYYMM, e.g. "202609") for historical basho, or omit for the latest basho.

tools.name: get_torikumi
tools.description: Get torikumi match results or schedule for a specific day (pathDate in YYYYMMDD format).

tools.name: list_basho
tools.description: List current and archived Grand Sumo basho available in o-sumo, along with their page URLs and API endpoints.
